intro.title: Company Profile
intro.p1: Shanghai Ningxin Trading Co., Ltd. is a precision metal supply chain management company. We are not a factory — we are your Managed Sourcing Partner in China, helping European OEMs and EMS providers find, evaluate, and manage quality precision manufacturing suppliers.
intro.p2: Our core categories span MIM (metal injection molding), precision springs, CNC machining, and metal stampings. Through rigorous supplier screening — on-site audits, technical evaluation, quality system review — we select only the Top 20% from 100+ candidate factories.
intro.p3: Our team brings 15+ years of precision manufacturing and engineering experience, delivering DFM reviews, tolerance analysis, FEA simulation, and full quality control. We serve clients across medical devices, industrial automation, and 3C electronics in Europe.

products.title: Capabilities
products.subtitle: Integrated supply chain services across four core precision metal categories

categories.name: Precision Springs
categories.desc: Through our vetted partner factories, we supply all types of precision springs. Partner facilities feature Taiwanese CNC coilers, CNC heat treatment furnaces, and automatic fatigue testers — covering micro springs to heavy industrial springs.
specs: Materials: Carbon/Alloy/Stainless steel, Music wire, Copper alloy

categories.name: Metal Stampings & Contacts
categories.desc: Partner factories equipped with 25T-200T precision presses and high-speed stamping lines. Products include contact clips, EMI shielding cans, precision terminals, retaining clips, and wave springs. In-house die development supports complex multi-station progressive tooling.

categories.name: MIM (Metal Injection Molding)
categories.desc: Full-process MIM production capability (feedstock → injection → debinding → sintering → post-processing) for complex precision parts in stainless and alloy steels. Complex geometries net-shaped in one forming process, eliminating secondary machining.

categories.name: CNC Precision Machining
categories.desc: Partner shops equipped with imported CNC turn-mill centers and 5-axis machines. Specializing in aluminum, stainless steel, titanium, and engineering plastic parts. Full lifecycle service from prototype to mass production.
